2607.13402.title: Price of Fairness in Bandits: A Tight Minimax Characterization
2607.13402.paper_summary:
In bandit problems, standard regret-minimizing algorithms treat exploration as an amortized cost, which can expose early participants to unfair ex-ante losses in settings such as clinical trials. Recent work addresses this by evaluating the sequence of per-round expected rewards through the generalized $p$-mean, interpolating between utilitarian welfare ($p=1$), Nash welfare ($p\to0$), and Rawlsian fairness ($p\to-\infty$). Although tight guarantees are known for $p\ge0$, the strictly fair regime $q=-p>0$ remains unresolved because negative-power means are dominated by the smallest per-round rewards.
  For $σ$-sub-Gaussian rewards with nonnegative means, the best prior algorithm relied on uniform early exploration and achieved regret $O(k^{(q+1)/2}/\sqrt{T})$, while the only general lower bound was the classical $Ω(σ\sqrt{k/T})$. Thus it was unclear whether the extra dependence on $k$ was intrinsic to strict fairness or an artifact of uniform exploration.
  We close this gap by identifying the exact polynomial price of strict fairness. Using a needle-in-haystack construction, we prove an algorithm-independent lower bound $Ω(σ\sqrt{k^{\max(1,q)}/T})$; for $q>1$, this shows that the penalty $k^{q/2}$ is information-theoretically unavoidable. We then introduce \textsf{UCB-HARE} (Harmonic Anchored Rank Exploration), which replaces uniform exploration with an inverse-weighted harmonic rank schedule protected by a certified positive-mean anchor. Its regret is $\widetilde{O}(σ\sqrt{k^{\max(1,q)}/T})$, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Experiments on synthetic instances confirm that \textsf{UCB-HARE} improves over uniform-exploration baselines, with gains increasing as $q$ grows.
2607.13402.paper_summary_zh:
在強盜問題中，標準的後悔最小化算法將探索視為攤銷成本，這可能使早期參與者在臨床試驗等環境中面臨不公平的事前損失。最近的研究通過評估每輪期望獎勵的序列來解決這個問題，使用了廣義的 $p$-均值，這在功利主義福利 ($p=1$)、納什福利 ($p\to0$) 和羅爾斯公平 ($p\to-\infty$) 之間進行插值。雖然對於 $p\ge0$ 已知有緊密的保證，但嚴格公平的範疇 $q=-p>0$ 仍然未得到解決，因為負冪均值被最小的每輪獎勵所主導。  
對於具有非負均值的 $σ$-次高斯獎勵，最佳的先前算法依賴於均勻的早期探索，並達到了後悔 $O(k^{(q+1)/2}/\sqrt{T})$，而唯一的通用下界是經典的 $Ω(σ\sqrt{k/T})$。因此，額外對 $k$ 的依賴是否是嚴格公平的內在特性，或是均勻探索的產物，仍然不明朗。  
我們通過確定嚴格公平的確切多項式代價來填補這一空白。使用針對針的構造，我們證明了一個與算法無關的下界 $Ω(σ\sqrt{k^{\max(1,q)}/T})$；對於 $q>1$，這表明懲罰 $k^{q/2}$ 是信息理論上不可避免的。然後我們介紹了 \textsf{UCB-HARE}（和諧錨定排名探索），它用一個受認證的正均值錨保護的反向加權和諧排名計畫取代了均勻探索。它的後悔為 $\widetilde{O}(σ\sqrt{k^{\max(1,q)}/T})$，與下界相匹配，僅差對數因子。在合成實例上的實驗確認，\textsf{UCB-HARE} 在均勻探索基準上有所改善，隨著 $q$ 的增長，增益也在增加。
